title: HSK2 Gate 9 · Western Jin
explanationEn: Gate 9: Western Jin. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第9关：西晋。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 中国人很早就觉得写字是一件很美的事。一千六百多年以前，有一个很有名的人。他的名字叫王羲之。他很小的时候就开始学写字。
passageEn: Chinese people early on felt that writing was a beautiful thing. More than sixteen hundred years ago there was a very famous man. His name was Wang Xizhi. He began learning to write when he was very young.

keyVocab.en: to think that ...; to feel that ...

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Chinese people early on felt that writing was a beautiful thing.
comprehension.answer: 中国人很早就觉得写字是一件很美的事。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.prompt: 短文里的“人”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 人 (rén) means "person" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “人”（rén）的意思是“person”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 中国人很早就觉得写字是一件很美的事。

options.text: The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
Chinese people early on felt that writing was a beautiful thing.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.

check.explanationEn: "中国人很早就觉得写字是一件很美的事。" means "Chinese people early on felt that writing was a beautiful thing.".
